title: CBSE CLASS 2 — Environmental Studies | Conservation Environment

questions.question: Assertion (A): We should always drink clean water. Reason (R): Dirty water can make us sick.

questions.question: Mrs. Sharma's family throws away a lot of plastic bags and bottles every day. What is a better way for them to help the environment?

options.explanation: Continuously buying new items increases waste.

questions.question: Imagine you are at a picnic in a park. After eating, you have some food wrappers and empty juice boxes. What is the most responsible thing to do to protect the environment?

questions.question: A factory near a village is releasing its waste into the nearby river. What will be the most harmful consequence of this action for the village people and nature?

options.text: The factory workers might lose their jobs.

questions.question: Your mother uses an old plastic bottle to store pencils. Which environmental practice is she following?

options.explanation: Reducing means using less of something, but in this case, the bottle is being used again.

Recycling means breaking down an item to make a new one, but in this case, the bottle is being used again.

questions.question: During a school picnic in a park, Maya sees many empty snack wrappers and plastic bottles lying on the grass, even though there are dustbins nearby. What is the *most responsible* thing Maya and her friends should do?

options.explanation: Ignoring the litter does not help keep the park clean.

options.text: Collect their own waste and put it in the dustbin, and gently encourage others to do the same.
options.explanation: Taking responsibility for their own waste and encouraging others sets a good example.

options.text: Complain to the park authorities later.
options.explanation: Complaining later does not address the immediate issue of litter in the park.

questions.question: Why is it harmful to throw garbage, especially plastic, into rivers and oceans?

options.text: It makes the water look pretty.

options.text: It helps the fish find food.
options.explanation: Plastic waste is not food for fish and can harm them.
